text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah, hah...!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes, I caught it, I got it...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hell yeahhh~~~!!
(Waaaaaahhh--!)

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea Machikane Tannhauser was 
such an incredible girl!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
She's the girl people were talking about a 
bit after the Japan Derby! She has a 
positive and friendly personality.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't have something like 
"overwhelming talent!", but she's a strong 
girl who keeps trying without ever giving 
up.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: To keep trying without giving up... I see.

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
—Um, excuse me! Could I interview you 
briefly about how you're feeling right 
now?

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: Especially around... Machikane Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice, nice. Spread the Tannhauser 
charm to the world~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"She really steps up when it counts, you 
know. ...Heheh, just saying."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's hurry home and run! I've 
gotta give it my best too!

While walking through the underground 
passage to pick up Matikanetannhauser... I 
heard faint voices talking.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —I just really wanted to thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Today, um, I was really able to give it my 
all! I was able to challenge it as the 
best Rice I could be...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... I think it's really all 
thanks to Bourbon-san.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So... that's why... Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...The same goes for me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To get away from you as you gave chase, 
I've become many times stronger than 
before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I look forward to working with you in 
the Senior Year as well.

"Having praised one another, the two of 
them happily walked back toward the 
waiting room. As I watched them leave—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I suppose that wraps up the 
Classic Year chapter.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I have returned! We won, Trainer! Yay!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Now... putting our celebration aside for a 
moment, I actually have a suggestion—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Now that the Classic Triple Crown is over, 
I've been thinking about what I'd like to 
challenge next!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember what the Chairwoman told 
you during summer training camp?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Things like ‘I'm not drawn to her track 
record,’ or ‘It's because she's so 
ordinary that she's charming!’"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm really happy, but to be honest, I 
guess there's part of me that... still 
isn't satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, someone who can give you a push 
is usually strong, cool, and radiant, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy people expect a lot from me and 
I wanna deliver, but... the more I think 
about it, the less I know how to actually 
do that~

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So for now, I've decided to just follow 
wherever my heart leads me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"And the one that really got me fired up 
was, without a doubt, the 'Tenno Sho 
(Spring)'...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I know, it won't be a walk in the park! 
It's a 3,200m GⅠ long-distance race to 
decide the strongest stayer, after all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the tactics and maneuvering are 
far more difficult, and his stamina must 
still be nowhere near enough.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, winning on that massive stage in 
spring... it's something you can't help 
but dream about, right?!

Though she's probably oblivious to it as 
usual, that's a very positive way of 
looking at it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"So, not quite as a preliminary match for 
it, but I'd like to fit in one 
long-distance race before spring."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Like the 3,400 meters of the Diamond 
Stakes, for example!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...How about it?

I have no particular reason to refuse. In 
fact, if that's what she wishes, I want to 
make it come true as much as possible. And 
so—
choice_data_list:
Got it, let's aim for the Diamond Stakes 
next.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right... I'll do my best, do my best, 
I'll do my absolute best~~!

And so, our next challenge was set for the 
long-distance GIII race, the Diamond 
Stakes!
